## Spec compliance

✅ The immutable range contains only integration tests, verification documentation and retained evidence; no product changes. The current bead's explicit failure-path teardown follow-through was applied together with the compatible frozen brief and parent directions. Current bead comments are empty.

✅ Both real-process fixtures register their owned child/orphan PIDs immediately and execute independent finally cleanup. Positive-PID validation precedes registration; observed exited children are skipped, child exits are awaited, and fixture resources are removed afterward. Missing/error ps output produces explicit inspection unavailability. Existing ownership, no-kinship, dirty/unmerged, stopping and retention assertions remain intact.

✅ Actual denied remove-task-worktree output feeds Workflow Finish and asserts the preserved unknown fact, both retained paths, completed delivery and independent caller-owned deferred measurement.

✅ The ordinary integration fixture consumes real settled original/retry collection history through dispatch-text check-evidence, report-status acceptance/status/collection, and scope-dispositions projection/keys. Its assertions distinguish simulated from live-kind fixture evidence, keep the historical required finding pending, require a supported elsewhere-fixed disposition, reconcile repaired/rejected/outstanding/occurrence counts, and check byte-identical repeat collection. Fixture measurements and human/semantic inputs are explicitly identified as synthetic.

✅ The producer/parser Launch now persists invocationId ep-parser-contract; all existing assertions and production missing-ID guard are retained.

✅ verification.md preserves initial 20/23 outcomes, explicit base reproductions, separately landed profiler correction and focused six-suite reruns, linked-worktree packaging failure and exact-source standalone-clone pass. Its aggregate coverage is expressly qualified and does not claim final phase-6 completion. Frozen B4 results remain 0 pass / 2 fail / 3 ambiguous, distinct from the new diagnostic 5/5 comparisons. Native Linux /proc remains untested, and live-isolation ps/descendant/stage-routing limitations remain explicit.

## Focused reachability checks

Risk: new teardown/inspection wrappers could be unused or leave a sibling fixture on the old inspection path. Checked their call sites and the two real-process fixture bodies: both use withFixtureProcesses and fixtureProcessAlive; all six process-fixture PIDs are owned, including two separately registered orphans.

Risk: feeding canned cleanup results might assert a shape unrelated to real Finish. Checked the real coordinator worktree-sweep dispatch and Finish parsing at coordinator.js:2345–2363 plus its worktreeSweepPrompt contract. The fixture feeds actual helper lines into the expected fields and checks the established prefix-normalized unknown fact and kept resource paths.

Risk: integration fixture might start from an uncollected model rather than real immutable source collection. Checked its immediate setup: real report-status collection archives the original split review and ready retry before the new fixture copies and consumes that settled run.
